title: DNA Stretched to the Sun
script: You contain a universe within. What if you unraveled the DNA from every cell in your body? It's a question that sparks curiosity. The answer lies in the microscopic world. Each cell packs a huge amount of genetic material. But that's not even the strange part. The DNA in a single one of your cells would stretch about 2 metres if uncoiled. And all the DNA in your body laid end to end would reach the Sun and back many times. This means every cell is like a tiny, intricate library. The scale is almost impossible to comprehend. You could fit the entire human genome in a space smaller than a grain of salt, yet it contains the blueprint for your entire body. Save this so you remember it.
